title: Gated Cellar
prompt: drum n bass, dufry, fred again
description: A dark subtractive square sub that stays in the cellar while a stepped tremolo gate chops it into euclidean and ply'd stutters. Over 32 cycles the gate rate ratchets up, the low-pass cracks open and snaps shut, and bitcrush grit fades in and out — dry and clicky, never wet.
code:
setcpm(174/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 g0 c1>*2").s("square")
    .ply("<1 1 2 1 2 4 2 1>/2")
    .euclid(5, 8)
    .lpf(sine.slow(23).range(220, 760))
    .resonance(saw.slow(13).range(6, 15))
    .lpenv(tri.slow(11).range(1.5, 4))
    .lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.08)
    .tremolosync("<4 8 16 8>/8").tremolodepth(0.7)
    .crush("<16 12 8 5>/8")
    .coarse("<1 1 2 1>/4")
    .shape(sine.slow(17).range(0.05, 0.32))
    .gain(0.95)
)
